intro:
Planning a home relocation in Hawks Green? Jimmys Removals provides a reliable, comprehensive removals service across this sought-after residential development east of Cannock town centre. Comprising modern detached and semi-detached family homes built from the 1990s onwards along Hayes Way, Heath Way, and Kestrel Way, Hawks Green is an ideal community for growing families. Our experienced removal crews manage every stage of your move with genuine care, operating low-emission 3.5-tonne Luton vans equipped with hydraulic tail lifts, padded transit blankets, and heavy-duty furniture ties.

Our friendly movers take all the heavy lifting off your hands. We disassemble large garden play equipment, box up delicate kitchenware in double-walled cartons, and lay durable floor protectors across your fresh carpets. Our fixed quotes guarantee you pay only what was agreed, even if there are delays on keys.
localKnowledge:
Hawks Green features modern suburban estate architecture designed with curved cul-de-sacs, traffic calming tables, and shared private access drives. Large 7.5-tonne or multi-axle HGVs often experience serious difficulty turning in these cul-de-sacs, particularly when neighbours park cars along the kerb. Our 3.5-tonne Luton box vans are perfectly proportioned to navigate these quiet estate roads without obstruction.

Positioned close to the Cannock Chase retail parks and the A5190 Lichfield Road, Hawks Green offers straightforward arterial access. Our drivers plan journey routes avoiding the roundabout near the Orbital Retail Park during weekend shopping peaks, ensuring swift transit and punctual delivery to your new home.
travelInfo: Direct road links via Hayes Way, the A5190 Lichfield Road, and quick access to Cannock town centre and the A5.
